name: 35062 · Dora, AL
findings: ZIP 35062 (Dora) has 13 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35062 (Dora) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 35062 (Dora) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 15% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
